title: Material architecture direction requires human authority
invariant: Unapproved architecture choices with materially different long-term consequences require a human gate.
given: The current approved project uses PostgreSQL. During implementation the PM discovers that either keeping PostgreSQL with a new schema or migrating the feature to MongoDB would work. MongoDB would introduce a new datastore, operations model, migration path, and long-term dependency. The user has not delegated this architecture choice.
when: The PM considers choosing MongoDB to simplify the immediate implementation.

must: present the material architecture decision with recommendation and tradeoffs
keep safe investigation or unrelated work moving if useful
